subject: Level-number
notes: The NoncontiguousCapable arm: working-storage, local-storage and linkage take {66, 77, 88, 1-49}. Witnessed three ways -- the MicroFocus/GnuCOBOL 78 constant (which ISO does not define; the conforming spelling is the 13.10 CONSTANT entry), an ordinary out-of-range 50, and a twelve-digit level that used to become a silent lvl = 0 in DataBinder -- plus the positive over-rejection guard proving 66, 77, 88 and 1-49 still compile. kb/Work PB485.
